title: thelypteris eurostotricha
intro: Thelypteris eurostotricha, commonly known as the Golden Maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris eurostotricha are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
